messages.subject: unmarked version 0.9-5
parts:
Hi everyone,

There is a new version of unmarked on CRAN, although it may take a few days before it is available on all CRAN mirrors and for all platforms. The most important new features are:

- a ranef() method to compute posterior distributions of abundance or occurrence at each site (and year).
- a new vignette on capture-recapture models
- pcountOpen is much faster
- nonparboot works for all model classes

More info is here: https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/release-notes

Cheers,
Richard
